paths_are_relative_to: Original BanditGittinsEval repository; archives are not part of this portable package.

fit_conventions.logistic_39: Arm-only L2 LIBLINEAR at C=100 with an explicit intercept column.
fit_conventions.rasch39: L2 LIBLINEAR at C=100; logit is X39 times coefficients plus an additive question effect, with no separate intercept.
fit_conventions.question_effect_sign: An additive item effect is the negative of item difficulty in the conventional Rasch sign notation.
fit_conventions.rasch_row_score: Keep observed labels and fill unseen entries with fitted probabilities, then average the whole row.
fit_conventions.scope: Pooled model-prompt best-arm identification over five phases, as an adaptation of the original per-model PromptEval method.
